quotes.locator: Lowest middle-class taxes of any province
quotes.speaker: BC NDP
quotes.text: BC families earning less than $100,000 pay lower provincial taxes than in any other province in Canada.

quotes.speaker: BC NDP
quotes.text: 97% of local governments have adopted zoning changes that are paving the way for 300,000 more homes across B.C.

quotes.locator: A million more people connected to a family doctor
quotes.speaker: BC NDP
quotes.text: One million more people have been attached to a family doctor or nurse practitioner since 2018 – 700,000 in the last three years alone, as more than 4,000 people get matched every week.

quotes.speaker: BC NDP
quotes.text: Since 2017, we’ve invested in 250 major school capital projects, including new schools, additions and seismic upgrades, along with 330 new school playgrounds, benefiting more than 90,000 kids.

quotes.speaker: BC NDP
quotes.text: We’ve hired over 250 more RCMP officers to keep our communities safe. And we’ve added 240 new police training seats to train more officers to fight crime (a 225% increase in seats).

quotes.speaker: BC NDP
quotes.text: We expanded access to addiction treatment by making opioid agonist treatment medications free for all British Columbians – ensuring money isn’t a barrier to getting addiction treatment.

quotes.speaker: BC NDP
quotes.text: We’ve protected 20% of B.C.’s land and water, on our way to 30% by 2030.

quotes.locator: Partnering with First Nations to improve stewardship
quotes.speaker: BC NDP
quotes.text: We’re expanding guardian programs with First Nations, increasing boots on the ground to protect and look after B.C.’s lands, waters and forests.

quotes.speaker: BC NDP
quotes.text: Build an economy free from the US, work with the Prime Minister to open new markets, build the infrastructure and homes B.C. needs, and grow industries while training British Columbians so they are first in line for skilled trades jobs with bigger paycheques.

quotes.speaker: BC NDP
quotes.text: Support workers and businesses facing tariffs, keep costs down for families and strengthen the health care and public services British Columbians rely on more than ever during a trade war.

quotes.speaker: BC NDP
quotes.text: The new campaign, which will be triple the size of B.C.’s first successful efforts, will expand into Republican-controlled “red” states where doctors and nurses are facing laws that restrict their ability to provide life-saving reproductive care.

quotes.speaker: BC NDP
quotes.text: The campaign will also now target Canadian health-care professionals living and working in the U.S., with new incentives to bring them home, including loan forgiveness and support with moving expenses.

quotes.speaker: BC NDP
quotes.text: Eby’s new “Built in BC and Canadian” plan will apply to ministries, Crown agencies and health authorities, and require them to put B.C. and Canadian-made goods and materials to work on public projects, wherever it is viable.

quotes.speaker: BC NDP
quotes.text: Eby says he will increase the speculation and vacancy tax by one percentage point, from 1% to 2% for domestic speculators and from 4% to 5% for foreign speculators.

quotes.speaker: BC NDP
quotes.text: The BC NDP will also introduce a new Unsold Condo Tax on finished condos left empty for more than a year.

quotes.speaker: BC NDP
quotes.text: To seize this generational opportunity and secure more economic independence from the United States, B.C. will double its production and export of critical minerals within five years.

quotes.speaker: BC NDP
quotes.text: A portion of B.C.’s revenue will also be dedicated to climate action programs that help families and businesses choose less costly clean energy and create new jobs.

quotes.speaker: BC NDP
quotes.text: To support families while Trump’s harmful actions cost British Columbians, David Eby’s plan will include suspending the provincial motor fuel tax by 10 cents per litre on gasoline and diesel.

quotes.speaker: BC NDP
quotes.text: The plan also includes a “price guard”, which will empower the BC Utilities Commission to enforce strict pricing rules and cap excess industry margins.

quotes.speaker: BC NDP
quotes.text: The BC NDP will use a “price guard” to cap profit margins on essentials like milk, eggs, cheese, butter, and poultry.

quotes.speaker: BC NDP
quotes.text: Invest in local food infrastructure by partnering with Ottawa to build an independent, regional wholesale food terminal in the Lower Mainland.

quotes.speaker: BC NDP
quotes.text: If re-elected, the BC NDP will match donations to the Canadian Red Cross up to $20 million for people affected by this summer’s wildfires, especially to support those who are uninsured and underinsured.

quotes.speaker: BC NDP
quotes.text: Eby committed to working with the Prince Rupert Port Authority, Gateway Partners and the federal government to keep expanding the port’s network that links ships, trains and trucks.

quotes.speaker: David Eby
quotes.text: Our expanded campaign will highlight that we will protect a woman’s right to choose and that doctors never have to navigate a for-profit system, which bankrupts half a million Americans every year.

quotes.speaker: BC NDP
quotes.text: Over 96% of residents, individuals who make $190,000 or less, will see no tax increase. The highest earners will pay slightly more through a 2% point increase on the top two tax brackets and a new bracket for income over a million dollars.
Scrap the Carbon Tax.
